first_pitch.line: Thank you for your time, Mr. Webb. We build AI-powered operations systems for municipalities, and we install a resident response agent that we can put in place in 21 days.

pitch.note: heuristic; Frannie confirms against the full transcript

our_price_mentions.line: The way it works is we train it on your own documents, with a named operator, and the install is $18,000, which pays for itself quickly.
The audit is $1,500, and that could fit under the threshold.

objection_candidates.line: Look, I like the idea. But anything we buy goes through procurement, and above our bid threshold the governing body has to pass a resolution. I'd need a formal contract to take to council.
And honestly we just adopted the budget. Anything new is next year's cycle, unless it's small.
Maybe. I don't know our threshold offhand. Can you send me a contract template and your insurance certificate so our solicitor can look?
Also, residents here are skeptical of AI. The council will ask whether it gives wrong answers on things like OPRA deadlines.
